controllerType: K5 Electronic Control (AHE59, LCD operation panel)
type: Flatseam / specialized sewing machine electronic control box

specs.display: LCD panel with icons for sewing mode, presser foot, needle position, trimming, soft start, voice, and segment display
specs.factoryResetMethod: Long press factory reset touch switch on panel for 3 seconds to restore factory program
specs.monitorAccess: Press P + light level/shear line button together to enter monitoring mode (shortcut)
specs.trimmingAccess: Press P + (+) button together to enter trimming mode (shortcut)

errorCodes.solution: Turn off the power switch and restart after 30 seconds. If the controller still does not work, please replace it and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the power switch and restart after 30 seconds. If the controller still does not work, please replace it and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Under-voltage — input power supply voltage is low (less than 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect the power to the controller. Check the input power supply voltage (not less than 176V). If the power supply voltage is low, start the controller after it recovers the voltage. If the controller still does not work, please inform the manufacturer and replace the controller.

errorCodes.cause: Over-voltage when the machine is off — input voltage too high (higher than 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect the controller power and check if the input voltage is too high (higher than 264V). If yes, please restart the controller when the normal voltage is resumed. If the controller still does not work when the voltage is at normal level, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Over-voltage in operation — supply voltage exceeds threshold during sewing
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power and restart after 30 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Solenoid circuit fault — solenoid connection is loose or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check if the solenoid connection is loose or damaged, change it in time. Restart the system after confirmation. If it still does not work, please inform the manufacturer and replace the controller.
Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds to see if it works well. If such failure happens frequently, seek technical support.

errorCodes.cause: Sewing motor blocked — motor power input plug is off, loose, or broken; or foreign matter tangled on the machine head
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the motor power input plug is off, loose, or broken, or if there is something tangled on the machine head. Correct these issues then restart. If it still does not work, please inform the manufacturer and replace the controller.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit fault — white braking resistor connector on power board is loose or has fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check carefully if the white braking resistor connector on the power board is loose or fall off. Plug it in tightly then restart the system. If it still does not work, please inform the manufacturer and replace the controller.

errorCodes.cause: Communication failure — connection between control panel and controller is off, loose, or broken
errorCodes.solution: Check carefully if the connection between the control panel and controller is off, loose, or broken. Restore it to normal and restart. If it still does not work, please inform the manufacturer and replace the controller.

errorCodes.cause: Machine head needle positioning failure — connection line between machine head synchronizer and controller is loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Check if the connection line between machine head synchronizer and controller is loose. Restore it and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Try 2 to 3 more times after power down. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor HALL failure — motor sensor plug is loose or has dropped off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check if the motor sensor plug is loose or dropped off. Restore it and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor reversion — motor is running in the wrong direction
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.
Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If it still does not work, please replace the controller and inform the manufacturer.

alarmCodes.cause: Stitch counter alarm — the stitch counter has reached the set upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press the factory reset key to cancel the alarm and reset the counter.

alarmCodes.cause: Trimming counter alarm — the trimming counter has reached the set upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press the factory reset key to cancel the alarm and reset the counter.
Please wait for 30 seconds, then turn on the power switch.

alarmCodes.cause: Trimming cutter is not back in original position, or safety switch still alarming after cutter returns
alarmCodes.solution: Check the trimming cutter is back in the original place. After checking, if still showing safety alarm, adjust the position of the sensor holder. If still cannot be solved, enter P66 parameter and change value from 2 to 0 to disable the safety switch.

alarmCodes.cause: Dormancy — machine has been idle and entered sleep mode, or controller fault
alarmCodes.solution: Shut down the system power supply. Wait 30 seconds then reconnect the power supply. If the controller still does not work, replace the controller and notify the manufacturer.

checks: Disconnect power to controller completely
Check input power supply voltage with a multimeter — must be at least 176V (220V rated -20%)
Do not restart until voltage is within 176V-264V range
Once voltage is normal, restart the controller
If error persists with correct voltage, replace the controller
Turn off system power completely
Check motor power input plug — must be firmly seated and not loose, off, or broken
Check for foreign matter (thread, fabric) tangled around the motor or machine head
Clear any obstruction and reconnect loose plugs, then restart
If motor is still blocked after plug checks, replace the controller

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-11 machine head needle positioning failure on K5-UT
checks: Check all connection lines between the machine head synchronizer and the controller
Reconnect any loose connectors at both the machine head end and the controller end
Restart the system
If problem persists, replace the controller

troubleshooting.symptom: Safety switch alarm on K5-UT — machine won't start
checks: Verify the trimming cutter has returned fully to its original home position after the last trimming operation
If cutter is in place but alarm remains, adjust the position of the induction sensor bracket
If still not resolved after adjusting sensor bracket, change P66 parameter from 2 to 0 to disable the safety switch alarm
Contact local service provider if above steps fail

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-06 solenoid circuit fault on K5-UT
checks: Turn off system power
Inspect all solenoid connections — check for loose, damaged, or disconnected wires
Reconnect or replace any damaged solenoid connectors
Restart and verify the error is cleared
If error returns, contact manufacturer for controller replacement
